The exhaustive test covered the entire domain and found zero mismatches. One thing worth noting: negative x with the kernel — for x<0, numerator=exp(-|x|), so sigmoid = e^x/(1+e^x), correct. For large negative x, exp(-|x|) underflows to subnormal in FP64? exp(-|x|) for |x|=65504 is ~0 (underflows to 0 in double), numerator 0, denominator 1, output 0 — correct (sigmoid underflows FP16 to +0). Exhaustive test confirmed everything.

But one caveat: the probe ran all 63488 values in one tensor of N=63488 ≤ 131072, fine. Edge: N=1 masked case — masked loads fine. Input preservation not tested but irrelevant. I could add a small check for N=1 and fresh output, but the exhaustive probe already covers the core contract. Also check negative-zero and +0 outputs = 0.5 — covered exhaustively.
